tokens.text: can be thrown as a projectile

fields.description: Determines whether the entity hit will be set on fire. Note: the presence of this field in the component definition causes targets to catch fire regardless of the value set. To prevent fire, remove this field entirely from the component.

fields.title: Reflect On Hurt
fields.description: If true, this projectile will be reflected back when hit by another projectile or by taking damage.
fields.note: From 1.26.0, every projectile reflects projectiles that have `reflect_on_hurt: true` on hit, in addition to the existing damage-based reflection.

fields.title: Isolated Physics
fields.description: If true, this projectile is not affected by outside forces such as friction and drag.
fields.note: Available under the Custom Projectiles experimental toggle starting in format version 1.26.20.

generated_doNotEdit.title: Projectile
generated_doNotEdit.description: Turns the entity into a projectile: a thrown or shot entity that flies along a ballistic arc and reacts when it impacts a block, a fluid, or another entity.

fields.title: Anchor
fields.description: Reference point on the shooter used to position the projectile at spawn: `0` = origin (feet), `1` = eye height, `2` = middle of the bounding box.

fields.title: Angle Offset
fields.description: Additional upwards pitch (in degrees) applied to the shooter's aim direction at launch. Negative values aim downward.

fields.title: Catch Fire
fields.description: Legacy default for whether the projectile sets the entity hit on fire. Prefer the `catch_fire` on-hit subcomponent.

fields.title: Crit Particle On Hurt
fields.description: If `true`, critical-hit particles are spawned on the projectile when it is struck.

fields.title: Destroy On Hurt
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile is removed from the world when struck.

fields.title: Gravity
fields.description: Downward acceleration (blocks per tick squared) applied each tick while in flight. Higher values make the projectile fall faster.

fields.title: Hit Ground Sound
fields.description: Identifier of the sound to play when the projectile hits a block. Defaults to `hit_sound` when empty.

fields.title: Hit Nearest Passenger
fields.description: If `true`, when the projectile hits a vehicle with at least one passenger, the on-hit behavior is applied to the passenger closest to the impact point instead of the vehicle itself.

fields.title: Hit Sound
fields.description: Identifier of the sound to play when the projectile hits an entity. Also used for block hits when `hit_ground_sound` is not specified.

fields.title: Homing
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile steers towards an active target while in flight.

fields.title: Ignored Entities
fields.description: Array of entity identifiers that the projectile will pass through without registering a hit.

fields.title: Inertia
fields.description: Fraction of the projectile's velocity preserved each tick while traveling through air. Values below `1.0` cause it to slow down over time.

fields.title: Is Dangerous
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile is flagged as dangerous, affecting AI reactions and certain client-side behaviors.

fields.title: Isolated Physics
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile uses a dedicated ballistic physics path and ignores generic actor movement systems (friction, drag, etc.). Recommended for custom projectiles.

fields.title: Lightning
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile can channel a lightning bolt when it hits an entity during a thunderstorm.

fields.title: Liquid Inertia
fields.description: Fraction of the projectile's velocity preserved each tick while traveling through a fluid.

fields.title: Multiple Targets
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile can hit more than one entity over the course of its flight; if `false`, it stops at the first entity it hits.

fields.title: Offset
fields.description: Offset, relative to the `anchor`, at which the projectile is spawned when fired by the shooter.

fields.title: Fire Time
fields.description: Duration in seconds for which an entity set on fire by this projectile remains burning. Applied both by the legacy top-level `catch_fire` flag and by the `catch_fire` on-hit subcomponent.

fields.title: Hit
fields.description: Map of on-hit subcomponents that drive what happens when the projectile impacts a block, fluid, or entity. Each key is a subcomponent name and its value is that subcomponent's configuration.

fields.title: Owner Launch Immunity Ticks
fields.description: Number of ticks immediately after launch during which the projectile cannot hit its own shooter.

fields.title: Particle
fields.description: Particle effect emitted at the impact location when the projectile hits something.

fields.title: Potion Effect
fields.description: Default potion aux value associated with the projectile. Normally set programmatically by potion items; rarely useful at authoring time. A value matching the water potion is required for the `douse_fire` on-hit subcomponent to extinguish fires.

fields.title: Power
fields.description: Initial speed (in blocks per tick) at which the projectile is launched.

fields.title: Reflect Immunity
fields.description: Duration in seconds after launch during which the projectile cannot be reflected by being struck.

fields.title: Reflect On Hurt
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile reverses direction when struck, reflecting back towards the attacker.

fields.title: Shoot Sound
fields.description: Identifier of the sound to play when the projectile is fired.

fields.title: Shoot Target
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile is aimed at the shooter's current target (when one exists) rather than straight ahead.

fields.title: Should Bounce
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile bounces off surfaces and entities on impact instead of stopping.

fields.title: Splash Range
fields.description: Splash radius (in blocks) used when applying potion effects via the splash/lingering potion code path.

fields.title: Stop On Hurt
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile has its velocity zeroed out when struck.

fields.title: Uncertainty Base
fields.description: Base inaccuracy added to the launch direction. The total inaccuracy is `uncertainty_base - difficultyLevel * uncertainty_multiplier`.

fields.title: Uncertainty Multiplier
fields.description: Per-difficulty-level reduction in inaccuracy. See `uncertainty_base` for the full formula.
